links.outcome: Correlation between model-reported confidence/explanations and answer correctness in Arabic and English medical QA
links.effect: Model-reported confidence and explanations showed limited correlation with correctness, so stated confidence is an unreliable signal of accuracy.
links.quote: Tokenization analysis exposes structural fragmentation in Arabic medical text, while reliability analysis suggests that model-reported confidence and explanations exhibit limited correlation with correctness.

unlisted_practices: Language-aware LLM design and evaluation for low-resource languages
Tokenization analysis of non-English medical text

screen.reason: The study conducts a benchmark-based cross-lingual evaluation of LLM performance on Arabic vs. English medical QA datasets, focusing on equity/language gaps and reliability.
